title: Refine Sketchpad Tree Sibling Spacing
description: Refine the shared sketchpad tree spacing so that whenever a sibling transition goes from a leaf/property row to an expandable/group row at the same depth, one empty-row-sized gap is inserted before the group row. Apply this generically based on row kind and sibling transition, preserve compact spacing within consecutive property rows, hierarchy, tree lines, value-column layout, and row actions. Extend existing tests and make them pass.
